content: चकित {%a.%} [चक्-कर्तरि क्त] .²1 Shaking, trembling (through fear); भय˚, साध्वस˚ <ls>Me. 27</ls>. .²2 Frightened, made to tremble, startled; व्याधानुसारचकिता हरिणीव यासि <ls>Mk. 1. 17</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 46</ls>; <ls>Me. 14</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 73</ls>; <ls>Śivamahimna 2</ls>. .²3 Afraid, timid, apprehensive; चकितविलोकितसकलदिशा <ls>Gīt. 2</ls>; पौलस्त्यचकितेश्वराः (दिशः) <ls>R. 10. 73</ls>. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Trembling. .²2 Alarm, fear. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} With fear, in a startled manner, alarmingly, with awe; चकितमुपैमि तथापि पार्श्वमस्य <ls>M. 1. 11</ls>; सभयचकितम् <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 4. 4</ls>.
